messages:
sam_keller: Heads-up — BlueArc is asking for our full SOC 2 Type II and a bridge letter before they commit to a 10-day POC. They also asked whether we can provision a temporary dedicated namespace or just share redacted logs.

olivia_legal: We can issue a bridge letter once NDA is signed. Bridge will reference SOC 2 Type II, the audit period, and state that limited evidence extracts can be shared for POC purposes only. Need BlueArc's legal entity name and the scope they want.

sam_keller: Legal name: BlueArc Systems LLC. POC scope: ingestion API traces (sampled), auth events for demo accounts, config snapshots. They prefer a dedicated sandbox but will accept redacted production extracts if needed.

dan_security: Sandbox preferred from a security POV. If we must share production extracts, we require: signed NDA, agreement not to re-use customer content, redaction of PII/IPs, and a manifest of files shared. Also limit to hashed user ids.

maria_gonzalez: Quick checklist: 1) confirm NDA signed and countersigned, 2) get exact date ranges and number of sample records, 3) define redaction rules, 4) ops to provide pre-signed read-only link with expiry.

leo_ops: Ops feasibility: we can spin a temporary namespace (short-lived tenant) for the POC but that takes ~2 business days to provision; quicker path is a curated evidence bundle and a pre-signed S3 link with 48-72h expiry. We can also set ACL to IP allowlist if they provide IPs.

olivia_legal: I'll request the NDA from BlueArc and draft the bridge letter. Draft language will include: 
```
Redwood Inference Bridge Letter
Date: <date>
To: BlueArc Systems LLC
We confirm Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report covering <start> to <end>. This letter authorizes temporary limited access to specified, redacted evidence extracts for the sole purpose of evaluating Redwood's service in connection with BlueArc's POC. Access conditioned on executed NDA and Redwood's redaction policy. Access expires <expiry> unless extended in writing.
```

sam_keller: BlueArc legal says they can sign NDA today if we can provide the bridge letter and sample bundle by EOD. Can legal/ops expedite?

dan_security: We can expedite redaction and manifest prep but warning: no raw DB dumps, no customer content, and log samples must be trimmed to exclude request bodies containing customer text.

leo_ops: I'll prepare a 48h pre-signed link and manifest. Default expiry 48h, can extend to 7 days with legal sign-off. Will include: api-requests-sampled.jsonl, auth-events-sampled.jsonl, config-snapshot.yaml. Links are read-only.

evidence-bot: Uploaded redacted_SOC2_excerpt_2024.pdf to secure store: https://secure.redwood.example/soc2/redacted_SOC2_excerpt_2024.pdf (access restricted)

olivia_legal: NDA received (signed by BlueArc). Draft bridge letter sent to internal reviewers.

maria_gonzalez: Security approves the 48h bundle with hashing for user ids and removal of emails and IPs. Confirmed no request bodies with customer text will be shared.

leo_ops: Bundle ready — pre-signed link created. Will post link after legal final sign-off on bridge letter.

sam_keller: Thanks — please post link as soon as bridge letter is cleared. BlueArc wants to start POC at 10:00 PT tomorrow. Can we have access by 09:30 PT?

leo_ops: Targeting 09:00 PT. Will coordinate with legal if extension needed.

olivia_legal: Bridge letter signed and sent to BlueArc (cc internal). Subject line: Temporary Evidence Access for POC — Redwood Inference.

sam_keller: BlueArc confirmed receipt and will start POC tomorrow morning. Appreciate everyone's quick turnaround. :rocket:
